summary: Preserve WLED's already-read CPU-clock field in each Foundation sample and saturated-telemetry record so cycle-based timing comparisons retain their frequency context.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Reuse the existing Foundation adapter's parallel Matrix /json/info response; no additional endpoint, request, firmware field, or diagnostic path.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Read-only host-side timing evidence serialization. Frozen thresholds, runtime behavior, device writes, and candidate firmware are unchanged.
scoped_evidence.root_cause: The firmware converts ESP cycle-counter deltas to microseconds using ESP.getCpuFreqMHz(), but the adapter discarded WLED /json/info clock from both normal samples and the saturated-telemetry raw record. This prevents a later reviewer from checking the timing context against the frequency reported at the same sample.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert the cpu_clock_mhz output fields and their adapter fixture assertions. No firmware rebuild or device change is needed.
evidence_sources: Espressif Arduino-ESP32 Esp.h: ESP.getCpuFreqMHz() delegates to getCpuFrequencyMhz() and getCycleCount() to esp_cpu_get_cycle_count(): https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/blob/master/cores/esp32/Esp.h
WLED json.cpp: /json/info clock is populated from ESP.getCpuFreqMHz(): https://github.com/wled/WLED/blob/main/wled00/json.cpp

ESP-IDF v4.4 performance guidance: cycle counters are per-core and flash-cache/binary-layout effects can vary short microbenchmarks: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/release-v4.4/esp32/api-guides/performance/speed.html
tests: python3 tests/hbnf_foundation_live_adapter.py: PASS; verifies clock appears in regular samples and saturated raw evidence using the same mocked /json/info read.
